content:
Priya Menon: Quick heads-up — running a compact "roadmap blitz" this coming weekend to finalize Q3+OKR bets. Goal: pick 4 primary initiatives, surface customer asks, and lock launch criteria.
Alex Chen: dates/venue?
Priya Menon: Sat/Sun, 9am–2pm each day. We'll use main conference (Bldg A room 1) + overflow breakout rooms. Calendar invite will follow from @calendar-bot.
Maya Ortiz: I can facilitate the priority rubric session. Suggest we do a 20m lightning customer-ask review before each breakout.
Samir Patel: I'll bring the customer telemetry slides — 6 customers with high-cost inference patterns to discuss (Dedicated + Private asks).
Jenna Li: Need to decide whether "Dedicated autoscale burst" stays in core initiative or becomes an ops spike. I'm leaning core — enterprise demand.
Marco Alvarez: +1 to core, but call out engineering risk and infra dependency in the launch criteria.
Priya Menon: Proposed agenda snippet:
```
Sat 09:00 — Intros + alignment (Priya)
09:20 — Customer asks lightning (Samir)
09:40 — Prioritization rubric + voting (Maya)
10:10 — Breakouts: Initiative A/B (leads)
12:00 — Lunch
12:30 — Breakouts: Initiative C/D
13:30 — Consolidation + decisions
```
Alex Chen: Can we add a short "rollback & fallback" acceptance for each initiative? Important for Redwood's graceful degradation promise.
Maya Ortiz: Yes — include: canary plan, model-variant fallback, throughput SLOs, and telemetry cookbooks.
Samir Patel: For customer asks: list is (short): large SaaS customer: strict PII isolation + on-prem connector; fintech: KMS/HSM + audit logs; edtech: region-specific hosting + usage caps.
Jenna Li: Launch criteria template draft:
- Clear success metric (latency 95th below Xms; cost/unit below $Y)
- Rollout plan + canary window
- QA/eval prompts with baseline regression < Z%
- Support runbook + SLO alert thresholds
Marco Alvarez: I'll own the infrastructure readiness checklist (GPU capacity, autoscale test, network egress rules).
Priya Menon: Prework (due Fri EOD): each initiative lead drop a 1-pager w/ problem statement, target customers, estimated effort, and proposed launch criteria.
Alex Chen: I'll put a Google doc template and share. @ops-bot can you remind people Fri 3pm?
ops-bot: Reminder set for Fri 15:00 for channel #product — "Drop offsite prework: initiative 1-pager" :bell:
Maya Ortiz: Facilitator rotation: Sat AM (Maya), Sat PM (Priya), Sun AM (Jenna), Sun PM (Alex). Anyone swap? 
Samir Patel: I'm fine with Sat PM — will be taking notes for customer asks.
Priya Menon: AV note: bring HDMI adapters, mic for main room, whiteboards + markers. Ops will confirm.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Roadmap Blitz — Q3 OKR decisions" Sat 09:00–14:00 & Sun 09:00–14:00. Rooms booked: Bldg A rm1, Bldg B rm2, Bldg C rm3.
Alex Chen: Catering request — lunch for 12, note vegetarian and halal options.
Jenna Li: Also plan 10-min lightning demos from Eng-ML on the runtime kernel perf improvements — helps contextualize scope.
Marco Alvarez: Decision log format: one line per initiative: owner, priority (P0/P1/P2), launch criteria link, blockers.
Priya Menon: We'll use the doc to capture votes. Voting method: each participant has 3 dots to allocate across initiatives.
Maya Ortiz: Quick rubric reminder: customer value (0–5), revenue/ARR influence (0–5), infra risk (0–5, lower is better), time-to-value (0–5). We'll normalize.
Samir Patel: I'll paste customer excerpts + recommended ask mappings into the doc.
Alex Chen: If anyone wants to propose a late add, tag me + Priya. We should avoid scope creep during the weekend — tough constraint.
Priya Menon: Final ask — bring one real user story or support ticket that motivates your initiative. Practical stories help decisions.
Jenna Li: Sounds good. See you all Saturday. :rocket:
Priya Menon: Thanks — will post final checklist + doc links by EOD today. :white_check_mark:
